sources.observed: Public header directs system UI font creation to public UI factory; reserved dot names should not be requested. UI role remapping may vary by OS/platform.
Public AppKit separates system/UI factories and preferred text-style factory. No assertion that Notes uses a particular factory.
Public Mac text-style constants include Body and Caption1; does not establish CSS body syntax support.

inference: A shorthand text-style request may take a distinct public-facing CSS path and is a new discriminating experiment. No claim it selects UI Chinese fallback, fixes punctuation, or matches Notes. Installed Safari CSS.supports and complete Range widths must decide whether this page exposes an effect.
